lyrics:
[Intro: one metallic hit, low machine hum]

[Section A: dry techno kick, snarling bass pulse]

[Whisper: male voice, French, close]
Encore.

[Section B: metallic stabs on the off-beat, hi-hat]

[Section C: siren lead rising and falling]

[Break: kick drops out, belt motor, whisper]
Encore. Encore.

[Section D: full pulse, stabs doubled, snare rolls]

[Section E: siren lead and bass together, most intense]

[Whisper: same voice, slower]
Encore.

[Outro: motor winds down, one last metallic hit]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 125 BPM, 4/4, G minor. Relentless, precise and cold techno at a marching tempo.

VOICE: Instrumental. A man's voice whispers one French word four times, very close and dry, with no effect.

INSTRUMENTS: A hard, dry four-on-the-floor kick, a snarling, distorted monosynth bass pulse, sharp metallic stabs like struck steel, a siren-like lead that glides up and down, a tight closed hi-hat, snare rolls, a conveyor motor and machine hum.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, a hit and hum. 0:10 Section A. 0:30 First whisper. 0:34 Section B. 1:00 Section C, siren. 1:28 Break, motor and whispers. 1:44 Section D. 2:14 Section E, most intense. 2:48 Whisper. 2:54 Outro, motor winds down, last hit at 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2013 French dark techno: extremely dry and sharp, no reverb, every sound separate, loud and black.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The kick returning after the break at 1:44.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is pure menace with no setting. This gives it one: a warehouse that runs all night with no people in it, and a single human word left over.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Cold, driven, paused, driven harder.
